title: JESUS THE LOVING SHEPHERD
stanzas: Jesus the loving Shepherd, Calleth thee now to Come,Into the fold of safety, Where there is rest and room; come in the strength of manhood, Come in the morn of youth, Enter the fold of safety, Enter the way of truth.

Jesus, the loving Shepherd, gave His dear life for thee; Tenderly now He's calling wanderer, come to me; Haste for without is danger, come cries the Shepherd blest enter the fold of safety, Enter the place of rest

Lingering is but folly; Wolves are abroad today, seeking the sheep now straying, Seeking the lambs to slay; Jesus the loving shepherd, Calleth thee now to come, into the fields of safety, Where there is rest and room.
chorus: Lovingly, tenderly calling is He; Wanderer, wanderer, come unto me; Patiently standing there, waiting, I see Jesus, my Shepherd divine.
